children.text: oṃ akāro dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣa ukāras tūttaraḥ smṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: The sound a is its right wing, while the sound u is remembered as the left.

children.text: makāras tasya pucchaṃ vā ardhamātrā śiras tathā ||
children.translated_text: The sound m is its tail, and the half-mātrā is likewise its head.

children.text: pādau rajas tamas tasya śarīraṃ sattvam ucyate
children.translated_text: Its two feet are <s>rajas</s> and <s>tamas</s>, while its body is said to be <s>sattva</s>.

children.text: dharmaś ca dakṣiṇaṃ cakṣur adharmaś cottaraṃ smṛtam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s> is its right eye, and <s>adharma</s> is remembered as its left.

children.text: bhūr lokaḥ pādayos tasya bhuvarlokas tu jānunoḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhūr</s> world is at its feet, and the <s>Bhuvar</s> world at its knees.

children.text: svar lokaḥ kaṭideśe tu nābhideśe mahar jagat ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Svar</s> world is at the region of its waist, and the <s>Mahar</s> world at the region of its navel.

children.text: janalokas tu hṛdaye kaṇṭhadeśe tapas tataḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Jana</s> world is at its heart, and then the <s>Tapas</s> world at the region of its throat.

children.text: bhruvor lalāṭamadhye tu satyaloko vyavasthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Satya</s> world is situated between the eyebrows, in the middle of the forehead.

children.text: sahasram iti cātra mantra eva pradarśitaḥ
children.translated_text: And here the mantra <s>Sahasram</s> itself is indicated.

children.text: evam enaṃ samārūḍho haṃsaṃ yogavicakṣaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The adept in yoga who has thus mounted this <s>haṃsa</s> (mystic bird)

children.text: na badhyate karmacārī pāpakoṭiśatair api
children.translated_text: is not bound, though acting, even by hundreds of crores of sins.

children.text: āgneyī prathamā mātrā vāyavyaiṣā vaśānugā ||
children.translated_text: The first mātrā belongs to <s>Agni</s>; this next one belongs to <s>Vāyu</s> and follows his control.

children.text: bhānumaṇḍalasaṃkāśā bhaven mātrā tathottarā
children.translated_text: The following mātrā should resemble the disk of the sun.

children.text: paramā cārdhamātrā ca vāruṇīṃ tāṃ vidur budhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The wise know the supreme half-mātrā to belong to <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: kalātrayānanā vāpi tāsāṃ mātrāpratiṣṭhitā
children.translated_text: Or she has the three <s>kalās</s> (parts) as her faces and is established in their mātrās.

children.text: eṣa oṃkāra ākhyāto dhāraṇābhir nibodhata ||
children.translated_text: This is the <s>oṃkāra</s> that has been described; now learn it through the acts of concentration.

children.text: yoṣiṇī prathamā mātrā vidyunmālā tathāparā
children.translated_text: The first mātrā is <s>Yoṣiṇī</s>, and the next is <s>Vidyunmālā</s>.

children.text: pataṃgī ca tṛtīyā syāc caturthī vāyuveginī ||
children.translated_text: The third is <s>Pataṃgī</s>, and the fourth is <s>Vāyuveginī</s>.

children.text: pañcamīnām adheyā ca ṣaṣṭhī caindrī vidhīyate
children.translated_text: The fifth is <s>Nāmadheyā</s>, and the sixth is prescribed as <s>Aindrī</s>.

children.text: saptamī vaiṣṇavī nāma śaṃkarī ca tathāṣṭamī ||
children.translated_text: The seventh is named <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s>, and the eighth is <s>Śaṃkarī</s>.

children.text: navamī mahatī nāma dhruveti daśamī matā
children.translated_text: The ninth is named <s>Mahatī</s>, and the tenth is held to be <s>Dhruvā</s>.

children.text: ekādaśī bhaven maunī brāhmīti dvādaśī matā ||
children.translated_text: The eleventh is <s>Maunī</s>, and the twelfth is held to be <s>Brāhmī</s>.

children.text: prathamāyāṃ tu mātrāyāṃ yadi prāṇair viyujyate
children.translated_text: If one is separated from one's vital breaths during the first mātrā,

children.text: sa rājā bhārate varṣe sārvabhaumaḥ prajāyate ||
children.translated_text: one is born as a universal emperor in <s>Bhāratavarṣa</s>.

children.text: dvitīyāyāṃ samutkrānto bhaved yakṣo mahātmavān
children.translated_text: One who departs during the second becomes a mighty <s>Yakṣa</s>.

children.text: vidyādharas tṛtīyāyāṃ gandharvas tu caturthikām ||
children.translated_text: During the third one becomes a <s>Vidyādhara</s>, and during the fourth a <s>Gandharva</s>.

children.text: pañcamyām atha mātrāyāṃ yadi prāṇair viyujyate
children.translated_text: Then, if one is separated from one's vital breaths during the fifth mātrā,

children.text: uṣitaḥ sahadevatvaṃ somaloke mahīyate ||
children.translated_text: one dwells in the state of a deity and is exalted in the world of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ṣaṣṭhyām indrasya sāyujyaṃ saptamyāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam
children.translated_text: During the sixth one attains union with <s>Indra</s>, and during the seventh the abode of <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: aṣṭamyāṃ vrajate rudraṃ paśūnāṃ ca patiṃ tathā ||
children.translated_text: During the eighth one goes to <s>Rudra</s>, the lord of creatures.

children.text: navamyāṃ ca maharlokaṃ daśamyāṃ ca dhruvaṃ vrajet
children.translated_text: During the ninth one goes to the <s>Mahar</s> world, and during the tenth to <s>Dhruva</s>.

children.text: ekādaśyāṃ tapolokaṃ dvādaśyāṃ brahma śāśvatam ||
children.translated_text: During the eleventh one goes to the <s>Tapas</s> world, and during the twelfth to eternal <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: tataḥ paraṃ śuddhaṃ vyāpakaṃ niṣkalaṃ śivam
children.translated_text: Beyond that is the pure, all-pervading, partless, and auspicious reality:

children.text: sadoditaṃ paraṃ brahma jyotiṣām udayo yataḥ ||
children.translated_text: the ever-risen supreme <s>brahman</s>, from which the lights arise.

children.text: atīndriyaṃ guṇātītaṃ mano līnaṃ yadā bhavet
children.translated_text: When the mind becomes absorbed in that which is beyond the senses and beyond the qualities,

children.text: anaupamyam abhāvaṃ ca yogayuktaṃ tadādiśet ||
children.translated_text: one should point to it as incomparable, as absence, and as joined with yoga.

children.text: tadbhaktas tatsamāsaktaḥ śanair muñcet kalevaram
children.translated_text: Devoted to it and wholly attached to it, one should gradually release the body,

children.text: susthito yogacāreṇa sarvasaṅgavivarjitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: firmly established through yogic discipline and free from every attachment.

children.text: tato vilīnapāśo 'sau vimalaḥ kevalaḥ prabhuḥ
children.translated_text: Then, with his bonds dissolved, he is stainless, absolute, and sovereign.

children.text: tenaiva brahmabhāvena paramānandam aśnute ||
children.translated_text: Through that very state of <s>brahman</s>, he enjoys supreme bliss.

children.text: iti ||
children.translated_text: Thus.
